notablePrerequisites: A player controls another creature with toughness equal to 1.
description:
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on target creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness, triggering Hapatra and Skeleton Ship.
Resolve the Hapatra trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Skeleton Ship trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
